title.value: The Dormant Neuron Phenomenon in Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: The title of the paper is directly given as 'The Dormant Neuron Phenomenon in Deep Reinforcement Learning'.
title.quote: The Dormant Neuron Phenomenon in Deep Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: This paper examines the phenomenon of dormant neurons in deep reinforcement learning, highlighting how an increasing number of inactive neurons can affect learning. The authors propose a method called Recycled Dormant neurons (ReDo) to mitigate this issue, thereby maintaining the expressive power of networks and improving performance.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily discusses deep reinforcement learning and the dormant neuron phenomenon. It does not address climate or ecological sustainable development directly.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work, we seek to understand the underlying reasons behind the loss of expressivity during the training of RL agents.
